brief:
A settler in the Jordan Valley forcibly emptied Palestinian-owned water tanks at gunpoint, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident took place amid a severe heat wave and an ongoing water shortage affecting Palestinian communities in the region. Residents depend heavily on stored water supplies during periods of extreme temperatures and limited access to municipal sources.

The armed settler's actions left families without reserves of drinking and household water during dangerous heat conditions. The confrontation underscores deepening tensions over water access in the Jordan Valley, where Palestinian communities have faced repeated restrictions and disputes over resources. Specific details regarding the number of tanks emptied and the identities of those affected remain unclear.
title: Settler empties Palestinian water tanks at gunpoint in Jordan Valley
